historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly gates the image and flash but does not define whether both upgrade and downgrade are mandatory or how new firmware activates without AC restart.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds target/image validation, job evidence and recovery while leaving activation semantics for engineering.

original_test_intent: Demonstrate that an approved GPU firmware image can be transferred, programmed and activated through the BMC GPU-management workflow for the exact GPU without an AC power restart, for each required upgrade or downgrade direction, and that the resulting version and device health are correct.
original_method: Select the unique row; map SUT/BMC and GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF/board PN/current firmware; approve target image version/direction, signature/hash and compatibility; quiesce GPU jobs and capture inventory, driver, health, power and logs; upload once to the exact GPU through the supported BMC page; record validation, target, phases, progress and terminal job result without interruption; apply only the vendor-documented non-AC activation such as GPU reset, host reboot or live activation if required; prove from power telemetry that no AC loss occurred; verify active rather than staged version, enumeration, diagnostics and logs; retain rollback/recovery evidence.
manual_activity: An engineer supplies and authorizes the exact signed image/direction, validates compatibility and recovery, supervises the BMC upload/job and owns any host/GPU reset or rollback.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC firmware and GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF/board PN/VBIOS or firmware component identity
Approved upgrade and/or downgrade source/target versions and signed image hash
Vendor BMC workflow, job phases, timeouts and active-versus-staged version semantics
Allowed activation without AC: live, GPU reset, driver reload or host reboot
Maintenance window, workload drain, stable power/network, rollback image/tool and recovery/RMA path
safety_requirements: Match image component/board identity, signature and compatibility before upload
Drain all GPU processes and prevent schedulers from assigning work during flash
Use stable BMC/network/power and never refresh, navigate away, reset or interrupt an active job
Verify the selected GPU when multiple identical devices exist; do not assume index order
Stop on validation mismatch, wrong target, job stall/failure, unexpected AC event, loss of GPU/BMC, XID/AER or thermal/power fault; do not retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/image/direction, active/staged semantics, approval and recovery readiness
Collect pre-state and secret-safe upload/job/inventory/power/health evidence
Assist the approved BMC workflow only after separate execution confirmation and wait for its terminal state
Do not select firmware or GPU, invent activation, interrupt/retry flash, AC-cycle, declare version-only health or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact GPU/component, image and required upgrade/downgrade matrix
Approve non-AC activation, active-version and functional-health oracle
Review job/version/power/health evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The BMC browser workflow matches the source; no safe one-liner exists. A user-provided filename alone is insufficient without target, hash, signature, compatibility and activation approval.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Upload the single approved image to the verified GPU through BMC GPU Management, wait for documented terminal completion, perform only the approved non-AC activation, then verify active version and health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC WebUI add-file workflow, upgrade/downgrade title, no-AC-restart requirement, version check and 10/15-minute estimate remain; activation and direction matrix are pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed image-to-UUID transaction with recorded BMC job phases, vendor-approved non-AC activation, independent AC telemetry and post-activation functional health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable image/target identity, direction matrix, staged/active distinction, workload isolation, no-AC proof and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Upload success or a displayed target version does not prove programming, activation, no AC restart or GPU functionality.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some firmware components require a reset or cold power cycle despite successful programming; forcing unsupported live activation can brick or strand the GPU.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must state whether one upgrade and one downgrade are both required by the title, their execution order, and whether host reboot/GPU reset is allowed while AC restart remains prohibited. If the image cannot activate without AC, the result is a documented limitation, not permission to violate the criterion.
expected_evidence: GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF/board/component plus BMC/driver current active/staged versions
BMC target selection, upload validation and full job phases/progress/terminal result with timestamps
Approved non-AC activation record, power telemetry proving no AC loss, post active version
Enumeration/driver/diagnostic/XID/AER/BMC health, rollback/recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The unique source consistently requires GPU firmware change and no AC restart. Missing direction/activation detail is a project prerequisite rather than contradictory identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The BMC GPU-flash objective is clear. Compatible images, direction matrix, activation and recovery are supplyable prerequisites, so execution is approval-gated rather than blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2221 Wistron-BMC Sanity-00493-V003: approve the exact SUT/BMC and GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF/board PN/firmware component, whether both upgrade and downgrade are mandatory and their ordered source/target versions, signed image filenames/hashes/compatibility, BMC job timeout/terminal criteria, active-versus-staged version, vendor-approved activation without AC restart (live/GPU reset/driver reload/host reboot), no-AC telemetry oracle, workload drain, aborts, rollback/reflash and RMA recovery.

review_improvement: Turns an image upload into an auditable image-to-GPU programming and non-AC activation transaction with version, power, health and recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware can be accepted by a management UI yet remain staged, target the wrong identical GPU or require a later activation. Therefore version readback must identify the active component on the same UUID/serial after the approved activation step. `Without AC restart` prohibits only a specific power event unless engineering also forbids GPU reset or host reboot; those boundaries must be stated. Power telemetry is needed because an operator or controller could silently cycle AC. Repeating a failed flash increases brick risk and must not be automatic.
